chunks: And of Abraham who fulfilled his trust?

key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمَ: Abraham (peace be upon him), the patriarch

ai.seo_question: Who is described as having fulfilled his trust in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the term 'waffa' (fulfilled) is interpreted not merely as general obedience but as the complete and perfect execution of divine commands, highlighting Ibrahim’s status as a pure Imam free from minor sins. This verse serves as a foundational proof for the concept of 'Ismah' (infallibility) of the Prophets, distinguishing them as flawless models for the faithful to emulate in both belief and practice.
